crosswalks.label: Data Warehousing Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Data Warehousing Specialists directly ground sourcing, loading, transformation, mapping and quality work relevant to analytics engineering.

crosswalks.label: Database Architects
crosswalks.rationale: Database Architects ground data modeling/warehouse architecture while infrastructure ownership remains separate from the analytics transformation layer.

findings.summary: Analytics Engineering is better grounded in warehouse transformation/modeling than in generic Data Science; its core boundary is implementation of accepted semantics with traceable lineage.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make transformation/test success, source lineage, accepted business semantics and downstream analyst/statistical interpretation separate surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Analytics Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
